title: Executive or Senior Manager occupations for the purposes of international trade obligations

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
We consider these occupations to be executives or senior managers for the purposes of International Trade Obligations.

Occupation | ANZSCO Code
Advertising Manager | 131113
Chief Executive or Managing Director | 111111
Chief Information Officer | 135111
Corporate General Manager | 111211
Corporate Services Manager | 132111
Finance Manager | 132211
Human Resource Manager | 132311
Sales & Marketing Manager | 131112
Supply and Distribution Manager | 133611
